_note: Probe set v2. Changes from v1: (a) sixteen new dimensions covering states the modern instruments (MEQ30/5D-ASC/Hood) have no items for but the historical record documents heavily; (b) four probes per dimension instead of three; (c) rewritten probes for the four v1 dimensions that under-retrieved because the probe sentences were bad, not because the corpus was thin — dream_incubation (13 hits), possession (15), synesthesia (32), time (46). Probes are written as first-person report sentences in period-plausible register, because retrieval matches passages and we want experiential voice rather than topic vocabulary.

dimensions.label: Unity / ego dissolution
probes: I felt myself dissolve and become one with everything around me
the boundary between myself and the world fell away entirely
I no longer knew whether I existed as a separate person
all things appeared to me as a single undivided whole

dimensions.label: Inner light / photism
probes: a great light appeared to me though my eyes were closed
I was surrounded by a brightness clearer than the noonday sun
the darkness opened and a shining splendour poured in upon me
a light not of this world shone about me and I could not look upon it

dimensions.label: Ineffability
probes: what I saw cannot be set down in any words of ours
no tongue could utter and no pen could write what was shown to me
I lack all speech to declare that which I then perceived
were I to speak of it a thousand years I should not have told the half

dimensions.label: Noetic quality / revealed knowing
probes: in that moment I knew with utter certainty, without being taught
the whole of it was made plain to me at once, as knowledge given not learned
I understood the secret in an instant and doubted it no more
it was shown to me, and I saw that it had always been so

dimensions.label: Time distortion / timelessness
probes: an hour seemed to me a hundred years
I was outside of time altogether and knew neither before nor after
when I came to myself I found that a whole night had passed as a moment
past and future stood before me together as one present thing

dimensions.label: Sacredness, awe, reverence
probes: a trembling reverence came over me and I fell upon my face
I was filled with an awe such as I had never known in my life
sweetness and joy beyond all earthly delight flooded my heart
my hair stood up and a holy fear took hold of my whole body

dimensions.label: Anxious ego dissolution / terror
probes: a horror without cause seized me and I thought I should die
I was afraid though nothing was there to be afraid of
I felt myself falling into an abyss and could not cry out
a nameless dread came upon me in the darkness and I could not move

dimensions.label: Visionary encounter with a presence
probes: there stood before me a figure whom I knew was not of this world
an angel appeared to me and spoke, and I heard the words plainly
I beheld a form of great beauty which addressed me by name
the appearance of a man stood over against me and I was afraid

dimensions.label: Heard voice attributed elsewhere
probes: I heard a voice within me that was not my own
words were spoken to me inwardly which I did not compose
a voice sounded in my ear, and yet no man was present
I heard my name called distinctly when there was nobody by

dimensions.label: Ascent / celestial journey
probes: I was carried upward through the spheres and saw the heavens opened
my spirit was lifted out of my body and travelled far away
I passed through gate after gate rising ever higher
I was borne aloft and looked down upon the earth as a small thing

dimensions.label: Body dissolution / disembodiment
probes: I could no longer feel my limbs nor tell where my body ended
I saw my own body lying below me as if it belonged to another
my flesh became as if it were not mine at all
I seemed to stand beside myself and watch my own person

dimensions.label: Cross-modal perception
probes: I saw the sounds as colours moving before me
the music appeared to me in shapes and figures
every colour had its own voice and sang to me
the odour of it had a colour, and the colour a taste, all mingled together

dimensions.label: Elementary geometric imagery
probes: figures and patterns turned continually before my closed eyes
I saw wheels within wheels and circles of fire revolving
colours and geometrical shapes rose up unbidden before my sight
lattices and gratings of light spread themselves over everything I looked at

dimensions.label: Possession / agency displacement
probes: another moved my hand and I only watched it write
a spirit entered into me and used my tongue to speak
I was no longer the one acting, though the deed was done through me
something within me spoke and answered the questions put to it, and I could not stop it

dimensions.label: Dream / hypnagogic vision
probes: as I lay between sleeping and waking there came to me a vision
in a dream of the night it was shown to me plainly
I slept in the temple that I might receive an answer in a dream
I dreamed a dream and behold, and when I awoke the thing remained with me

dimensions.label: Melancholy, desolation, dark night
probes: a heaviness lay upon my soul and all light was withdrawn from me
I was left utterly dry and could find no comfort in anything
for many days I lived in a darkness of spirit without cause
God had hidden his face from me and I could not pray at all

dimensions.label: Substance-induced states
probes: after taking the draught my senses were wholly altered
having eaten of it, I fell into a laughter I could not govern, and strange fancies rose in me
the smoke being taken, I was transported and knew not where I was
I had taken the opium, and there followed such visions as I cannot describe

dimensions.label: Absorbed concentration
probes: my mind became fixed upon one point and would not wander
I held the image steady before my inner eye without effort
thought grew still and quiet until nothing stirred in me
so intent was I upon it that I heard nothing said to me

dimensions.label: Luminous emptiness / cessation
probes: the mind rested in its own nature, empty and clear
there was awareness without any object of awareness
all appearance ceased and yet knowing remained
like the sky, without centre or edge, luminous and unobstructed

dimensions.label: Bodily energetic phenomena
probes: a heat rose up along my spine and filled my whole body
I felt a burning sweetness in my breast that was not a fever
a power moved within me from below upward like a flame
my body glowed with warmth though I sat naked in the snow

dimensions.label: Felt presence of another
probes: I felt certain that someone was in the room, though I saw no one
there was a presence beside me which I could not see but could not doubt
I knew myself to be accompanied, though I walked alone
something stood behind me and I dared not turn my head

dimensions.label: Sleep paralysis / night pressure
probes: I awoke and could not move a limb, and a weight pressed upon my chest
the nightmare sat upon me and I could neither speak nor stir
I lay awake in terror while something held me down
I would cry out but no sound came, and I was as one bound

dimensions.label: Near-death and revival
probes: I was taken for dead, and when I revived I told what I had seen
in my extremity I passed through a darkness and came out into light
my soul departed a little way from my body and was brought back again
they thought me dead three days, and I had been in another place

dimensions.label: Apparition of the dead / grief-vision
probes: my mother appeared to me after her death and spoke with me
the dead came to me in the night and I knew him at once
he stood at the foot of my bed as plainly as in life, and he had been buried
since her death she has come to me often, and I am not afraid

dimensions.label: Fever, delirium, sickness-vision
probes: in the height of the fever I saw things that were not in the room
my sickness brought strange fancies which I believed while they lasted
in my delirium I spoke to people who were not there
the walls seemed to breathe and the figures on them moved as I lay ill

dimensions.label: Erotic / nuptial union
probes: he embraced my soul as a bridegroom his bride
a wound of love pierced me and the pain was sweeter than any pleasure
I was ravished and melted wholly into the beloved
my soul was drunk with love and desired nothing else forever

dimensions.label: Pain, ordeal, childbirth
probes: in the extremity of the pain I left myself and felt nothing
under the torment my mind went elsewhere and I was not there
in the throes of the birth I saw and heard things strangely
the pain was such that I no longer knew who was suffering it

dimensions.label: Music heard with no source
probes: I heard a music sweeter than any instrument, and none was playing
there was singing in the air about me and I could not tell whence it came
a harmony sounded through the house at the hour of his death
such melody filled my ears that all earthly music seemed harsh after it

dimensions.label: Transformation / animal form
probes: it seemed to me that I had become a beast and ran upon all fours
I felt my body change its shape and take another form
in that state I flew as a bird flies and saw with a bird's eyes
she confessed that she went out at night in the likeness of a wolf

dimensions.label: Magnetic / mesmeric trance
probes: under the passes of the magnetiser I fell into a deep sleep and yet answered
in the magnetic state she saw with her eyes closed and described distant things
being entranced, I obeyed without willing it and remembered nothing after
the somnambulist described the interior of her own body while sleeping

dimensions.label: Darkness, solitude, retreat
probes: shut in the dark cell for many days, I began to see and hear things
in that long solitude my mind turned upon itself and strange things came
having sat in the dark retreat, visions arose of their own accord
the silence itself became a sound that I could hear

dimensions.label: Fasting, vigil, austerity
probes: after fasting many days my sight became strange and clear
with long watching and little food, the visions began to come
I had eaten nothing for a week when the thing appeared to me
by scourging and vigil I brought my body low, and then it was given me

dimensions.label: Inspired speech / dictation
probes: the words came to me faster than I could write them down
I did not compose this; it was dictated to me and I set it down as given
the spirit of prophecy came upon me and I spoke before the people
my hand wrote what my mind did not know beforehand

dimensions.label: Rhythm, dance, ecstatic motion
probes: we turned and turned until the self was lost in the turning
the drumming carried me out of myself and I danced without weariness
in the dance they fell down as dead and afterwards told what they had seen
the shaking came upon them and they could not stand still

dimensions.label: Autoscopy / the double
probes: I met myself coming toward me and knew my own face
my double was seen by others in a place where I was not
there appeared a second self standing over against me
he beheld his own likeness sitting in his chair, and died soon after

dimensions.label: Uncanny recognition / foreknowledge
probes: I had never been in that place, and yet I knew every corner of it
it seemed to me that all this had happened before in the same way
I knew what he would say before the words were spoken
a strange familiarity came over me as though I remembered the future
